planningGate.approvalEvidenceRef: 2026-09-14 user request to standardize the evolved Sagajeong module without implementing another station

downwardPlan.summary: The host and planner only assemble read-only Unity presentation adapters and cannot change WI, order, dispatch, inventory, advertising or WorldRevision authority.

upwardValidation.summary: The module profile hard-codes ObservationPresentationOnly=true and operational, traversal, gameplay and distribution readiness false; no server or Simulation write path was changed.

downwardPlan.summary: No new station, Scene, Prefab, input or camera result is introduced.
Active host activation, missing required module rejection and unregistered station rejection are standardized.
The existing Sagajeong View becomes the first compatibility adapter without changing its generated world objects.
Eight shared module roles and their dependency order are frozen as a reusable profile.
Module state ordering, dependency blocking and assembly hash are deterministic.
PrivateReview, Ready, Blocked, NotProvided and BlockedByDependency remain explicit.
A station profile owns ordered required and optional layer modules, while adapters only report their read-only runtime contribution.

upwardValidation.summary: Byte-identical main sources passed 9 module, 54 spatial overlay, 10 H selection, 4 model and 7 operations-view EditMode tests in the isolated Unity project.
Scene, Prefab, MeshBuilder, camera constants and data assets were unchanged; Play Mode and Game View are deferred until a second active adapter or switching UI is implemented.

runtimeBoundary: Unity read-only station-diorama module discovery and visibility composition; server and Simulation remain authoritative

openFeedbackRefs: mobility, life simulation, business overlay and environment presentation do not yet register as host adapters
only Sagajeong is registered in the active module profile catalog
main Unity Editor Pipeline is unreachable while the project remains open
Play Mode, Game View and physical station switching input were not run

reopenCondition: module role contract, station profile, adapter contribution, visual output, operational authority or a second active station adapter changes
